name: VW Arts Gallery
author: vendweave

sections.description:
VW Arts Gallery is a modern and powerful WordPress plugin designed specifically for artists, photographers, and art gallery owners. Showcase your artwork in stunning gallery layouts with an innovative “View in Room” feature that allows potential buyers to visualize how the artwork would look in their space.

Key Features

  • Custom Artwork Post Type – Dedicated post type for managing your artwork
  • View in Room Feature – Display artwork in realistic room environments
  • Multiple Gallery Layouts – Grid and Masonry layouts
  • Elementor Integration – Drag & drop gallery builder
  • Inquiry System – Built-in contact form for potential buyers
  • Responsive Design – Works perfectly on all devices
  • Category Management – Organize artwork by categories
  • AJAX Loading – Smooth user experience
  • Customizable Settings – Extensive customization options

View in Room Feature

The unique “View in Room” feature allows you to:
* Upload custom room backgrounds for each artwork
* Adjust artwork positioning in the room
* Zoom and pan artwork for detailed viewing
* Provide realistic preview for potential buyers

Gallery Layouts

  • Grid Layout – Clean, organized grid with equal-height items
  • Masonry Layout – Pinterest-style layout with varying heights
  • Customizable Columns – 1 to 6 columns responsive layout
  • Hover Effects – Beautiful overlay effects with title and description

Elementor Integration

Full Elementor integration with:
* Dedicated VW Arts Gallery widget
* Live preview in Elementor editor
* Style controls for all elements
* Responsive settings

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the vw-arts-gallery folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to VW Arts Gallery > Settings to configure the plugin
  4. Start adding your artwork through VW Arts Gallery > Add New Artwork
sections.faq:
How do I display the gallery?

You can display the gallery in several ways:

  1. Shortcode: Use [vw-arts-gallery] in any post or page
  2. Elementor: Use the VW Arts Gallery widget in Elementor
  3. PHP Code: Use echo do_shortcode('[vw-arts-gallery]'); in your theme

What shortcode parameters are available?

  • layout – Gallery layout (grid/masonry)
  • columns – Number of columns (1-6)
  • limit – Number of items to display
  • category – Filter by category slug
  • show_title – Show/hide titles (yes/no)
  • show_description – Show/hide descriptions (yes/no)
  • image_size – Image size for thumbnails
  • gap – Gap between items in pixels

Example: [vw-arts-gallery layout="masonry" columns="4" show_title="yes"]

How does the “View in Room” feature work?

  1. When editing an artwork, you can upload a custom room background image
  2. The artwork will be displayed over this background on the single artwork page
  3. Visitors can zoom and pan the artwork to see details
  4. You can adjust the artwork position (left, center, right) in the room

Can I use my own room backgrounds?

Yes! You can:
* Upload custom room backgrounds for each individual artwork
* Set a default room background in the plugin settings
* Use different room styles for different artwork
